Inside the Factory

Want to see it live? Ask for a video call from the floor with your quote — we do them daily.

Why Sialkot

Sports-goods heritage. Sialkot produces roughly 70% of the world's hand-stitched footballs and supplies global sportswear — an industry built on short runs, frequent design changes and heavy decoration. That is why 50-piece orders are normal here and 1,000-piece minimums are not.
Cotton at the source. Pakistan grows its own cotton and Sialkot's region mills its own fleece and jersey — no imported-fabric premium on tees, hoodies and knitwear.
Export infrastructure. Dry port, express air links and 2,400+ exporters' worth of logistics mean DHL/FedEx door-to-door in 3–7 days is routine.
Deep decoration supply chain. Sublimation, embroidery, appliqué and print specialists within the city — the reason team kits and fightwear come from here.

Questions Buyers Ask Us

Where is the FABRIOZA factory located?

Saro Street, near Fateh Garh Road, Sialkot 51310, Punjab, Pakistan — in the city that produces most of the world's hand-stitched footballs and much of its sportswear. Phone/WhatsApp +92 328 2347875. A US sales presence in McDonough, Georgia supports American clients by appointment.

Is FABRIOZA a real factory or a trading company?

A factory. Production runs on our own 8 specialized lines with in-house cutting, stitching, sublimation, embroidery and finishing, 50,000+ pieces monthly capacity. We video-call from the production floor on request — the fastest way to verify any factory claim, including ours.

What certifications and audits does FABRIOZA hold?

ISO 9001 (quality management system) certification and an amfori BSCI social audit. Documentation with certificate numbers and dates is provided on request, and we encourage buyers to verify with the issuing bodies. We deliberately do not display badges we cannot document.

How does FABRIOZA control quality?

A 4-stage QC process on every order from 20-piece trials to bulk: incoming fabric inspection, in-line stitching checks, finished-garment measurement audit against the tech pack, and AQL 2.5 pre-shipment inspection with photo documentation sent to the client.

What are FABRIOZA's payment terms?

30% deposit to begin production, 70% before shipment, via traceable bank transfer. Samples are free (DHL included); trial orders are quoted per design with the cost credited toward your bulk order.

Verify Us, Then Test Us

Ask for the documents, take the floor video call, and start with 20 pieces. Quote in 24 hours.
